title: Vision Beat Himself With a Question
description: Why does Vision ask his enemy about a boat? The Ship of Theseus conversation in WandaVision turns a fight into a question of identity and memory. This recaps the 2021 finale only.
hook: Vision ended a fight with his own dead body by asking a question about a boat.
payoff: He unlocks them. White Vision remembers his life, declares himself Vision, and flies away.

units.speaker: Host
units.text: Vision ended a fight with his own dead body by asking a question about a boat.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: In WandaVision, White Vision is the original body, rebuilt by SWORD and sent to destroy Wanda’s Vision.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: But Wanda’s Vision is a creation of her magic. He has no original parts. Which one is actually Vision?

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: He asks about a ship. Replace every plank. Is it still the same ship?

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Now rebuild another ship with all the old planks. Which one deserves the original name?

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: The fight stops. Wanda’s Vision points out that the original body's memories are still there, just blocked.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: He unlocks them. White Vision remembers his life, declares himself Vision, and flies away.

units.speaker: Host
units.text: Same opponent. Same body. One question ended the fight that punches couldn't.
